text: I love it! It's great at what it's for -tracking habits- and the developer constantly improves the app! I have the pro version and it's quite rare for me to think it was worth it even months later. The free version was great too. I fully recommend it!
author: Stefania

text: I tested several apps in the "habit tracker" category before settling on this one. What I liked most was the intuitive graphics and ease of use. You can see at a glance how you carry out the different activities you pursue.
